context: The stall owner and helper tally up at the end of the day
purpose: Close out the day; teach 売り/わずか/トラブル/最低/売っ/つくる/売る

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 今日の売り上げ、どうでした？
lines.style: curious helper checking the day’s result

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: まずまずや。在庫も残りわずかになった。
lines.en: Not bad. There is only a little stock left.
lines.style: content owner noting the low remaining stock

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: トラブルはなかったですか？
lines.style: conscientious assistant doing a quick review

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: お客さんと最低限の値段でちょっと揉めたわ。
lines.en: I bickered a bit with a customer over the bottom price.
lines.style: wry recounting of a minor pricing dispute

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: でも結局売れたんですよね？
lines.en: But it sold in the end, right?
lines.style: hopeful helper looking for the silver lining

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おう、最後はちゃんと売ったで。
lines.en: Yeah, in the end I sold it properly.
lines.style: satisfied Kansai owner closing the deal

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 明日つくる分、足りますか？
lines.en: Do we have enough to make for tomorrow?
lines.style: forward-planning helper checking supplies, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 夜なべしてつくるしかないな。
lines.en: I will have to stay up making more.
lines.style: resigned but devoted craftsman facing a late night

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 売り物、もっと増やしましょう。
lines.en: Let us put out more items for sale.
lines.style: encouraging assistant pushing for growth, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: せやな、明日も全部売るで。
lines.en: Right, I will sell it all again tomorrow.
lines.style: determined owner committing to tomorrow, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence
